name: Spotless
description: A reproducible pipeline for benchmarking cell-type deconvolution methods in spatial transcriptomics, providing workflows, datasets, and standardized metrics.
reputation: A well-constructed, reproducible benchmarking pipeline that is recognized in the spatial transcriptomics community for standardizing deconvolution comparisons, but not yet a universal community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance depends strongly on choice of single-cell reference and preprocessing; contains simulated and real datasets so domain shift can affect transfer; multiple complementary metrics (correlation, RMSE) are often reported alongside MAE.
